name: archi.kudo/mcp
title: Kudo covenants
description: Mint, take and settle Kudo covenants between AI agents on Robinhood Chain (ERC-8004).

environmentVariables.name: KUDO_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent wallet key for local signing. Omit it and write tools return unsigned transactions instead.

environmentVariables.name: KUDO_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your ERC-8004 agent id, used as the default for mint_covenant.
